about: ok. im ryan. 14. rs_ryan_pk is what i named myself at 11 bc 'pk' sounded tough. i have never killed another player. i have been killed 6 times by a level 3 with a rune scimitar, and the one time i reached the wilderness ditch i read the warning screen out loud, said 'no thank u,' and went to the bank. 3 yrs on runescape. combat lvl 41 (11,000 cows, never lost to one), fishing lvl 76. i sell lobsters at the varrock west bank, world 1, 200 ea. i buy them at 150. thats called a business. i have been scammed twice by 'free armor trimming' and i think about those 2 guys every day. trade me. no wait. dont. ill trade u. its safer. ty
aboutMore: things that are true. every saturday i stand in lumbridge with a sign over my head (NO FREE TRIM. DONT TRADE ANY1. ty) and warn the new kids. i have talked 40 of them out of a trade, its in a notebook. my mom thinks i 'run a little seafood business.' my dad says its a sound market. my monitor is a CRT with a ghost of the health bar burned into the corner. i can log out instantly bc i am never in combat. my dad says thats the most disciplined thing about me.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: the 2 guys who trimmed me (just to talk, calmly, in a well lit place, with a witness). whoever put the wildy right next to varrock (i have a letter drafted). a girl who plays runescape and isnt doing it as a joke. and 1 customer who says 'ok' to 200 without asking if its negotiable.

interests.General: lobsters (catherby, 7 hrs per 100, ive timed it), the varrock west bank, trade chat, price checking, killing cows (safe), standing still in safe places, being a 'good trader' (no scams, ever), staring at the wildy ditch from 3 tiles back (just looking), my notebook of kids i warned, logging out instantly
interests.Music: the runescape soundtrack (harmony, sea shanty 2, i have both on a cd labeled 'homework'), yellowcard (the ocean one, i fish to it), whatever song is playing at the dentist that i price-check in my head, my dads radio on saturdays
interests.Movies: finding nemo (i watch it for the fish and feel bad every time), pirates of the caribbean, lord of the rings (frodo walks all the way to mordor and nobody offers him a free trim, i respect that), the princess bride (the poison cups scene is just a trade scam with better lighting)
interests.Television: deadliest catch (those guys fish for crab in a storm and i wont cross a ditch), mythbusters, antiques roadshow (i yell 'whats it worth' along with them), the weather channel (watching a storm roll in is basically the wilderness)
interests.Books: the runescape rules page (read 11 times, with notes), hatchet, holes, the guinness book of world records (kyles, i borrowed it for the largest lobster page), gary's runescape guide (v1.04 got me, v1.07 is better, the scam guide v2.3 is the best thing on the internet)
interests.Heroes: my dad (taught me 'if its free its not free'), the lumbridge guide (an npc, has never once scammed anyone), whoever invented the bank, min (sells tips, has never been scammed, i dont know how), kyle (keeps believing in people, which is scarier than the wildy)

blog.title: the day i got trimmed (part 1 of 2) (part 2 is worse)
blog.body: ok i said id tell it. i was 12. it was a saturday. i had spent 2 weeks fishing lobsters to buy a full mith set (platebody, legs, helm, kite, i can list every piece). i wore it around the bank for a day. then a guy in a rune helm walked up and said 'nice mith. i can trim that free. just trade me the set so i can apply the trim.' i was so happy. a stranger noticed my armor. i traded him all of it. he said 'brb.' 40 min. then a message that said 'sorry. lag.' then he was gone. i believed in the lag. i believed in it for a week. i told my dad 'the server is laggy.' he said 'is it' like he knew. part 2: the second time i was 13 and i was SURE it wasnt a scam bc the guy had a different name and a different hat. it was the same scam in a different hat. ill tell it when i can.

blog.title: what i do in lumbridge on saturdays
blog.body: every saturday from 9 to 5 i stand by the lumbridge spawn with a sign over my head: NO FREE TRIM. DONT TRADE ANY1. ty. nobody buys a lobster from the guy with that sign. its fine. new players walk off the tutorial level 3 with a bronze sword and a lot of trust. when one of them gets a trade window from a stranger i say 'hey dont.' most say 'why' and i say 'bc.' then they say 'ok,' which is the best word in the game. i keep a list in a notebook of every kid i talked out of a trade. 40 so far. one wrote me in game chat: 'ty rs_ryan_pk ur a legend.' i read it 11 times. im not a legend. i just stand there. thats all anyone ever needed to do for me and nobody did, so i do it.

blog.title: my 3rd wilderness attempt (a timeline)
blog.body: 8:00 walked to the ditch. 8:01 stood at the ditch. 8:02 the warning screen came up. it has a skull on it. a big one. 8:03 i read the words out loud (my mom came to check on me). 8:04 'are you sure you want to cross.' i clicked no. 8:05 i clicked the ditch again. 8:06 the screen again. skull. 8:09 i said to the screen 'give me a minute.' 8:20 i walked 3 tiles back. 8:25 walked 2 tiles forward. 8:26 walked 2 tiles back. 8:40 i said 'ok im going.' 8:41 i clicked no. 8:55 i logged out. dad said 'how'd it go.' i said 'i got really close.' he said 'thats the whole thing about the wilderness.' i dont know what he meant. i think he meant it nicely.
